notes: Enumerated 168 unique main-track papers across 36 numbered technical sessions; the program overview says 167, but the detailed schedule contains 168 and reconciles one-to-one to publisher DOI records.
The complete archival boundary is 16 papers in publisher-labelled ASPLOS 2025 Volume 3, 20 in ASPLOS 2026 Volume 1, and 132 in ASPLOS 2026 Volume 2.

Excluded three detailed-program keynotes and non-main workshop, tutorial, WACI, poster, social, and business blocks; also excluded three non-main Volume 3 records and three short Volume 2 archival keynote records.

Applied the strict ASPLOS rule to all 168 real papers: 158 CORE_SYSTEMS and 10 SYSTEMS_ADJACENT; every ML-themed included paper has a concrete architecture, compiler, runtime, scheduling, serving, training-system, or co-design mechanism.
Matched abstracts for all 168 papers (165 Semantic Scholar and 3 arXiv), 73 arXiv alternates, 41 publisher-exposed PDF links, 13 Zenodo artifacts, 5 code repositories, and 2 project pages.
Flagged 22 normalized program/publisher title differences and four author-list discrepancies; no duplicate DOI, normalized title, or canonical paper ID was found.

unresolved_fields: Official program overview count of 167 versus 168 unique paper entries in the detailed schedule and publisher reconciliation.

Independent title-rendering review for 22 normalized program/publisher wording differences.
Independent relevance-boundary review for Syno, retained as SYSTEMS_ADJACENT because its primary contribution is neural-operator synthesis with material systems evaluation.
Official PDF links for 127 papers not exposed in publisher-deposited metadata.
Artifact links for 155 papers not matched confidently; four matched artifacts retain naming or year-label discrepancies.
Code, project, slide, video, and BibTeX links not exposed by checked sources remain null per paper.
Author entity IDs and normalized affiliation entities/geography.
